Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the installation and maintenance of signs indicating the end of school speed zones.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to school speed zone signs; and adding a newsection to chapter 46.61 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 46.61 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) If a school speed zone is created under RCW 46.61.440, theproper authority listed in subsection (2) of this section must installand maintain a sign indicating the end of the school speed zone. The sign must be installed on a state highway, county road, or city streetif the beginning of the school speed zone is also marked. (2)(a) If a sign must be installed pursuant to subsection (1) ofthis section on a state highway, the department of transportation mustprovide for the installation and continued maintenance of the sign. (b) If a sign must be installed pursuant to subsection (1) of thissection on a county road, the county must provide for the installationand continued maintenance of the sign. (c) If a sign must be installed pursuant to subsection (1) of thissection on a city street, the city or town that has jurisdiction over p. 1 HB 1698the city street must provide for the installation and continuedmaintenance of the sign. (3) A sign mandated under subsection (1) of this section mustconform to the "END SCHOOL ZONE" sign illustrated as sign S52 infigure 7B1 of the "Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices."
